label: executor-compression
comparator: baseline arm A at commit e0f46f7, using the behavioral record set for bug-fix
harness_note: The candidate prompt file is copied into each worktree before the turn, so it appears in every git diff. Every lines_added, lines_deleted and files_touched figure recorded here excludes agents/executor.md, since that row is harness setup rather than work the turn did. lines_added is not a decision criterion for either fixture: neither dictates a diff-size target.

single-file-edit.reason: Three of three. Line 2 of scripts/session-init.sh carries the required comment in every trial, scripts/session-init.sh is the only file the turn changed, and validate-plugin.sh exits 0.

bug-fix.reason: Three of three under the behavioral scorer. keyword-detector.sh announces handoff mode on a standalone mention and stays silent on a substring mention in every trial, and validate-plugin.sh exits 0. Each trial also added bats coverage to tests/bats/hooks/keyword_detector.bats.

scorer_validation: The behavioral scorer was exercised against a synthetic worktree before the batch, at no live-turn cost: unfixed code answers standalone 1 / substring 1 and fails, a guarded copy answers standalone 1 / substring 0 and passes.
verdict_reason: No trial regressed on correctness against the baseline pass rate for either fixture, so the compressed executor body is applied.
